chapterInfo.content:
25
AWURADE mmoa ho nkamfoɔ
1AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn ne wo,
mɛma wo so na makamfo wo din
sɛ woayɛ anwanwadeɛ;
tete nteredee agyinatuo atim ayɛ nokorɛ.
2Na woadane kuro nkunkumaboɔkuo,
woama abandenden ayɛ abansini;
ananafoɔ aban afɛfɛ nyɛ kuro bio,
na wɔrento bio da biara da.
3Enti ɔman a ɛyɛ den bɛhyɛ wo animuonyam,
amanaman ahoɔdenfoɔ kuro bɛsuro wo.
4 # Yes 4.6; 30.28; 33.11 Na woayɛ aban a ɛyɛ den ama mmɔborɔni,
aban a ɛyɛ den ama ohiani, n’ahohia mu,
ahum ano dwanekɔbea, ahuhuro mu enwunu,
na atirimuɔdenfoɔ home ayɛ sɛ ahum ne osuo a ɛboro fasuo,
5Wobrɛɛ ananafoɔ hooyɛ ase
sɛ nkyɛkyerɛ so ahuhuro.
Nhyɛsofoɔ dwaeɛ dwom brɛɛ ase
sɛ mununkum nwunu ase ahuhuro.
Amanaman apontoɔ wɔ Sion bepɔ so
6 # Dwom 22.26-29; Mat 22.2 Na asafo AWURADE bɛto aman nyinaa pono wɔ bepɔ yi so: Sradeduane, nsa a akyɛ, sradeɛ ne ekyim, nsa a wɔasɔne soɔ. 7Na bepɔ yi so na ɔbɛyi anim ntoma a ɛkataa aman nyinaa anim, ne akatasoɔ a ɛkataa amanaman nyinaa soɔ no. 8#1 Ko 15.55; Adi 7.17 Ɔbɛmene owuo akɔsi daa, na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛpepa ani nyinaa so nisuo, na wayi ne man ahohora afiri asase nyinaa so akɔ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na waka.
9 # Dwom 48.14 Ɛda no na wɔbɛka sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛn ani ada ne so sɛ ɔbɛgye yɛn no nie; AWURADE a yɛn ani daa ne soɔ no nie. Momma yɛnni ahurisie, na yɛn ani nnye ne nkwagyeɛ no mu.
10Na AWURADE nsa bɛsi bepɔ yi so na wɔbɛtiatia Moab so wɔ n’afa, sɛdeɛ wɔtiatia nwira dodoɔ soɔ wɔ sumina soɔ; 11na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsam wɔ mu, sɛdeɛ osudwareni trɛ ne nsam dwareɛ no, na ɔbɛbrɛ n’ahantan ase, ɛne ne nsa adeyɛ no. 12Na n’afasuo a ɛyɛ den a ɛkorɔn no, ɔbɛbrɛ no ase adwiri agu fam, mfuturo mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn ne wo,
mɛma wo so na makamfo wo din
sɛ woayɛ anwanwadeɛ;
tete nteredee agyinatuo atim ayɛ nokorɛ.
Na woadane kuro nkunkumaboɔkuo,
woama abandenden ayɛ abansini;
ananafoɔ aban afɛfɛ nyɛ kuro bio,
na wɔrento bio da biara da.
Enti ɔman a ɛyɛ den bɛhyɛ wo animuonyam,
amanaman ahoɔdenfoɔ kuro bɛsuro wo.
Na woayɛ aban a ɛyɛ den ama mmɔborɔni,
aban a ɛyɛ den ama ohiani, n’ahohia mu,
ahum ano dwanekɔbea, ahuhuro mu enwunu,
na atirimuɔdenfoɔ home ayɛ sɛ ahum ne osuo a ɛboro fasuo,
Wobrɛɛ ananafoɔ hooyɛ ase
sɛ nkyɛkyerɛ so ahuhuro.
Nhyɛsofoɔ dwaeɛ dwom brɛɛ ase
sɛ mununkum nwunu ase ahuhuro.

Na asafo AWURADE bɛto aman nyinaa pono wɔ bepɔ yi so: Sradeduane, nsa a akyɛ, sradeɛ ne ekyim, nsa a wɔasɔne soɔ. Na bepɔ yi so na ɔbɛyi anim ntoma a ɛkataa aman nyinaa anim, ne akatasoɔ a ɛkataa amanaman nyinaa soɔ no. Ɔbɛmene owuo akɔsi daa, na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛpepa ani nyinaa so nisuo, na wayi ne man ahohora afiri asase nyinaa so akɔ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na waka.
Ɛda no na wɔbɛka sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛn ani ada ne so sɛ ɔbɛgye yɛn no nie; AWURADE a yɛn ani daa ne soɔ no nie. Momma yɛnni ahurisie, na yɛn ani nnye ne nkwagyeɛ no mu.
Na AWURADE nsa bɛsi bepɔ yi so na wɔbɛtiatia Moab so wɔ n’afa, sɛdeɛ wɔtiatia nwira dodoɔ soɔ wɔ sumina soɔ; na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsam wɔ mu, sɛdeɛ osudwareni trɛ ne nsam dwareɛ no, na ɔbɛbrɛ n’ahantan ase, ɛne ne nsa adeyɛ no. Na n’afasuo a ɛyɛ den a ɛkorɔn no, ɔbɛbrɛ no ase adwiri agu fam, mfuturo mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
